prior_app_1_5_1_evidence.scope: Historical1.5.1 evidence only; does not validate a1.5.2 container build or installation.

scope: Frontend 1.4.17 and app 1.6.12 (both published). Frontend: the card skips a render when a new hass object leaves everything it shows or gates unchanged compared with a snapshot taken at the last render (own climate entity, correction number and its unique resolution, localize, connection, connected flag, user, config, locale, entity registry); the same object, the same states object, a pending request, a busy mode change or a load always render; gestures and commands still check the live hass. App: circuit_cold judged in the day phase only for radiators too (owner decision 2026-11-23): setback or unknown phase never judged, an existing (active) finding holds up to 24 h, also while the basis is unknown, HA is away or across an app restart (the floor cold_pause bound, for both types, no new constant, rule digest unchanged); radiator settle 2 h after a phase, target or mode change. Betriebsueberwachung outbox: an event superseded by a later one of the same component is never delivered; the first non-superseded event is delivered and leaves with the superseded ones before it only after success; one delivery per poll and order across components kept. room_learning.json: a damaged entry drops only that entry. Room page: Zuruecksetzen needs a second tap within 5 s; influence step 1; no stale or unsupported VM acknowledgement; failed changed reports retried after 10 s; pong deadline after reading; German panel texts; '(n-mal)'; time display race. Saved state schema, report contents and control behaviour unchanged. No container build, HA/Supervisor installation, real HA service call or physical acceptance is claimed. Follow-up (review-ha-3): limit_cold judged in the day phase only (an active notice holds through setback and HA gaps up to 24 h); room learning day level settles again after a target change; room search text normalised once per page; German webhook text in health_alerts.py (same copy in tools/monitoring); correction-dial confirmation from HA timestamps only (newer state than at the request), no phone clock. Pre-publish GO notes (review-ha-4): docs qualify the overnight hold (while the circuit keeps heating during setback) and state the day-phase length a new circuit_cold needs (radiator 5 h, underfloor 7 h); DOCS describe newest-state-wins; a report publish failing since app start retries after the 120 s period.
